arms.ACTIVE_LOGREG: batch active class-balanced SGD logistic loss selecting highest inclusion probability
arms.STATIC_SEED_CENTROID: descending cosine similarity to included seed

eligibility: after excluding the exact contaminated first raw line, every line with exactly five tab-separated fields and class exactly include or exclude; empty title, PMID, abstract or MeSH remains eligible
forbidden_claims: generality beyond this one public screening pool

gates.G1_BINDING: exact body, excluded-row hash, 25539 eligible unique records, binary labels and exact five-field rows
gates.G3_INCREMENTAL: ACTIVE_LOGREG recall at 10 percent minus max(RANDOM,STATIC_SEED_CENTROID) >= 0.10
gates.G5_NO_RANDOM_HARM: ACTIVE_LOGREG recall at 10 percent >= RANDOM recall at 10 percent

initial_seed: included and excluded eligible records with lexicographically smallest sha256(source_id + colon + record_identity), shared by all arms

outcomes.analysis_unit: one citation-screening pool; no cross-world inferential p-value

record_identity: sha256(title + tab + pmid + tab + abstract + tab + mesh); duplicate identities are a binding failure
text: whitespace-normalized title plus abstract plus MeSH terms with pipe replaced by space
